name: ladlelink
description: Local-first recipe manager with portion scaling and URL import

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ladlelink/types && npm run build -w @ladlelink/units && npm run build -w @ladlelink/scaling && npm run build -w @ladlelink/parser && npm run build -w @ladlelink/url-guard && npm run build -w @ladlelink/ll-bridge
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ladlelink/web && npm run build -w @ladlelink/server
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:packages && npm run build:capacitor -w @ladlelink/web && npm run sync -w @ladlelink/mobile
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @ladlelink/server" "npm run dev -w @ladlelink/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @ladlelink/units && npm run test -w @ladlelink/scaling && npm run test -w @ladlelink/parser && npm run test -w @ladlelink/url-guard
